turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a local tournament for a fighting game I love. I want to enter but I'm scared I'll get destroyed.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's how almost everyone feels before their first one. Local events are usually very welcoming to newcomers.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Different question. I need to present one piece from my design portfolio in the interview and I'm stuck.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I've got a long list here and I'll want your verdict once I've read the last one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A rebrand for a local bakery, which is my prettiest work, but the brief was pretty simple.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: An app redesign for a bus company, less pretty, but I ran real user tests and it improved bookings.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a poster series for a music festival, really bold and fun, done as a personal project.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And that's the last one. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The bus app is your strongest story, because you can show a problem, testing, and a measurable result. The bakery looks lovely but there's less to talk about. The festival posters show personality, and might be good to mention briefly at the end.
